description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the PlayerInfo plugin for WPEFramework. It handles initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and gathering player codec information. It interacts with system services, manages codecs, and registers/unregisters components relevant to player info.

classes.name: PlayerInfo
classes.description: A class implementing player info plugin functionality, including initialization, request processing, and interaction with player properties.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PlayerInfo plugin, setting up codecs, registering notifications, and handling configuration.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, releases codecs, and deinitializes components.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Information
methods.description: Returns basic plugin info; empty in this implementation.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Process
methods.description: Processes HTTP requests, especially GET, and returns player codecs info as JSON.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Info
methods.description: Populates the response JSON with current audio and video codecs.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation events, scheduling cleanup.
